verses.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.pt: E aqueles três homens cessaram de responder a Jó; porque era justo aos seus próprios olhos.
verses.en_web: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.en_bbe: So these three men gave no more answers to Job, because he seemed to himself to be right.

verses.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.pt: Então se acendeu a ira de Eliú, filho de Baraquel, o buzita, da família de Rão; acendeu-se a sua ira contra Jó, porque este se justificava a si mesmo, e não a Deus.
verses.en_web: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.en_bbe: And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was angry, burning with wrath against Job, because he seemed to himself more right than God;

verses.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.pt: Também contra os seus três amigos se acendeu a sua ira, porque não tinham achado o que responder, e contudo tinham condenado a Jó.
verses.en_web: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.en_bbe: And he was angry with his three friends, because they had been unable to give him an answer, and had not made Job's sin clear.

verses.en: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
verses.pt: Ora, Eliú havia esperado para falar a Jó, porque eles eram mais idosos do que ele.
verses.en_web: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.
verses.en_bbe: Now Elihu had kept quiet while Job was talking, because they were older than he;

verses.en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, Eliú viu que não havia resposta na boca daqueles três homens, acendeu-se-lhe a ira.
verses.en_web: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
verses.en_bbe: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, he was very angry.

verses.en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
verses.pt: Então respondeu Eliú, filho de Baraquel, o buzita, dizendo: Eu sou de pouca idade, e vós sois, idosos; arreceei-me e temi de vos declarar a minha opinião.
verses.en_web: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
verses.en_bbe: And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, made answer and said, I am young, and you are very old, so I was in fear, and kept myself from putting my knowledge before you.

verses.en: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.pt: Dizia eu: Falem os dias, e a multidão dos anos ensine a sabedoria.
verses.en_web: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
verses.en_bbe: I said to myself, It is right for the old to say what is in their minds, and for those who are far on in years to give out wisdom.

verses.en: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verses.pt: Há, porém, um espírito no homem, e o sopro do Todo-Poderoso o faz entendido.
verses.en_web: But there is a spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.
verses.en_bbe: But truly it is the spirit in man, even the breath of the Ruler of all, which gives them knowledge.

verses.en: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
verses.pt: Não são os velhos que são os sábios, nem os anciãos que entendem o que é reto.
verses.en_web: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
verses.en_bbe: It is not the old who are wise, and those who are full of years have not the knowledge of what is right.

verses.en: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.pt: Pelo que digo: Ouvi-me, e também eu declararei a minha opinião.
verses.en_web: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
verses.en_bbe: So I say, Give ear to me, and I will put forward my knowledge.

verses.en: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.pt: Eis que aguardei as vossas palavras, escutei as vossas considerações, enquanto buscáveis o que dizer.
verses.en_web: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
verses.en_bbe: I was waiting for your words, I was giving ear to your wise sayings; while you were searching out what to say,

verses.en: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
verses.pt: Eu, pois, vos prestava toda a minha atenção, e eis que não houve entre vós quem convencesse a Jó, nem quem respondesse às suas palavras;
verses.en_web: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
verses.en_bbe: I was taking note; and truly not one of you was able to make clear Job's error, or to give an answer to his words.

verses.en: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
verses.pt: pelo que não digais: Achamos a sabedoria; Deus é que pode derrubá-lo, e não o homem.
verses.en_web: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom, God may refute him, not man;’
verses.en_bbe: Take care that you do not say, Wisdom is here; God may overcome him, but not man.

verses.en: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.pt: Ora ele não dirigiu contra mim palavra alguma, nem lhe responderei com as vossas palavras.
verses.en_web: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.en_bbe: I will not put forward words like these, or make use of your sayings in answer to him.

verses.en: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
verses.pt: Estão pasmados, não respondem mais; faltam-lhes as palavras.
verses.en_web: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
verses.en_bbe: Fear has overcome them, they have no more answers to give; they have come to an end of words.

verses.en: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
verses.pt: Hei de eu esperar, porque eles não falam, porque já pararam, e não respondem mais?
verses.en_web: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
verses.en_bbe: And am I to go on waiting while they have nothing to say? while they keep quiet and give no more answers?

verses.en: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.pt: Eu também darei a minha resposta; eu também declararei a minha opinião.
verses.en_web: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
verses.en_bbe: I will give my answer; I will put forward my knowledge:

verses.en: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.pt: Pois estou cheio de palavras; o espírito dentro de mim me constrange.
verses.en_web: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
verses.en_bbe: For I am full of words, I am unable to keep in my breath any longer:

verses.en: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
verses.pt: Eis que o meu peito é como o mosto, sem respiradouro, como odres novos que estão para arrebentar.
verses.en_web: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
verses.en_bbe: My stomach is like wine which is unable to get out; like skins full of new wine, it is almost burst.

verses.en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
verses.pt: Falarei, para que ache alívio; abrirei os meus lábios e responderei:
verses.en_web: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
verses.en_bbe: Let me say what is in my mind, so that I may get comfort; let me give answer with open mouth.

verses.en: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
verses.pt: Que não faça eu acepção de pessoas, nem use de lisonjas para com o homem.
verses.en_web: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
verses.en_bbe: Let me not give respect to any man, or give names of honour to any living.

verses.en: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
verses.pt: Porque não sei usar de lisonjas; do contrário, em breve me levaria o meu Criador.
verses.en_web: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles; or else my Maker would soon take me away.
verses.en_bbe: For I am not able to give names of honour to any man; and if I did, my Maker would quickly take me away.
